title: Anti-inflammation lipid nanoparticles enable localized mRNA therapy for inflammatory bowel disease.
snippet: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is an incurable disorder that requires long-term management, which is limited by suboptimal efficacy and systemic toxicity of current treatments.
